update_calendar.title: Update Calendar
update_calendar.description: Scrape the reservations and update the ical file. If true, booking fields are ignored. Placeholder weekdays and time still apply.

reservation_date.title: Reservation Date
reservation_date.description: The date to book a slot on, format: yyyy-mm-dd. Defaults to one week from now

reservation_default.title: Reservation Default
reservation_default.description: The default date to book a slot on if no explicit date is given

reservation_skip.title: Reservation Skip
reservation_skip.description: The dates to skip when trying to book a slot, format: yyyy-mm-dd

opponent.title: Opponent
opponent.description: The opponent to book a slot with

times.title: Times
times.description: The times to try to book a slot on the leden banen

leden_only.title: Leden Only
leden_only.description: Only try to book a slot on the leden banen

non_leden_times.title: Non Leden Times
non_leden_times.description: The times to try to book a slot on the non-leden banen

placeholder_weekdays.title: Placeholder Weekdays
placeholder_weekdays.description: Weekdays for placeholder events on evenings that are not booked yet. Use monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, or sunday. Defaults to tuesday and thursday.

placeholder_time.title: Placeholder Time
placeholder_time.description: Start time for placeholder events, HH:MM. The event stays 45 minutes.
